locator.title: Плиточный клей: 5 вопросов экспертам по ремонту
locator.lead: В статье — ответы экспертов на главные вопросы по плитке во время ремонта

current_heading.text: Почему результат разный у разных мастеров

nearest_text_before.text: Поэтому чаще выбирают решения, где все уже согласовано. Например, в линейке ВОЛМА есть связка грунтовка + клей + основание. Так проще подобрать систему и ниже риск ошибок.

nearest_text_after.text: В линейке ВОЛМА закрыты все основные сценарии ремонта:

image_reading: A wide black advertising composition centers two upright VOLMA tile-adhesive bags, Мультиклей T 34 and Экстраклей T 80, framed by thin white geometric lines.
Large product-category copy occupies the left side; a male expert portrait and blue testimonial text occupy the right side.

The composition is a text-heavy branded graphic, so only a restrained optical accent on the existing product packaging is safely movable while all typography, numbers, logos, packaging geometry, portrait, and layout remain unchanged.
analysis.article_context: The body image follows the article’s argument that reliable results come from a coordinated system of predictable materials and introduces two specialized VOLMA tile adhesives within a product range for different repair scenarios. The animation should reinforce confident product choice and expert trust without altering the advertisement’s claims or layout.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The coordinated VOLMA product range supports dependable tile-installation results by offering suitable adhesive solutions for different repair conditions, backed by expert confidence.
structured_intent.primary_action: A single soft blue optical highlight passes across the two visible adhesive packages.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Both package labels are left with a subtle, balanced blue emphasis while every informational element remains unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The image remains a credible, unchanged expert-endorsed VOLMA product advertisement presenting both adhesives as reliable members of the same coordinated range.

models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed composition. A narrow, low-intensity blue sheen begins moving immediately across the Мультиклей bag, continues smoothly through the gap and over the Экстраклей bag, and gently diminishes near the end. The final frames retain a subtle, even label accent on both packages; all copy, logos, product geometry, portrait, white framing lines, and layout remain static and legible.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. A restrained blue sheen moves once from left to right across both VOLMA bags at an even pace, then settles as a soft balanced accent on both product labels in the final frame. Keep every word, number, logo, package shape, portrait, and layout unchanged.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, one soft optical highlight progresses continuously from the left package to the right package with moderate, uniform motion. Its intensity eases naturally after crossing the second label and resolves into a restrained balanced emphasis on both product faces at the endpoint. The camera and every semantic graphic element stay unchanged.
models.positive_prompt: With the camera fixed, let one soft blue highlight travel steadily across the two adhesive bags from left to right, finishing with both labels subtly and evenly illuminated. Preserve all text, numbers, logos, packaging, portrait, and graphic layout exactly.

models.scene_plan: A compact four-second focused moment with a fixed camera. A single subtle blue sheen crosses both central bags in one clean left-to-right pass, moving slightly faster than the five-second variants and easing at the end. The last frame shows both labels evenly accented while the advertisement’s text, portrait, products, lines, and layout remain completely stable.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. One subtle blue sheen sweeps smoothly left to right across both product bags and resolves by the final frame into an even soft accent on both labels. All typography, numbers, logos, portrait, package geometry, and layout remain unchanged.
